tbesh_html:
§ Mephaath = "splendour" or "height"
a city of Reuben allotted to the Merarite Levites lying in the district of the Mishor, near Moab

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Mophaath or Mephaath, a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: (Jeremiah 48:21) or מֵיפַעַת; or מֵפַעַת; from H3313 (יָפַע); illuminative;
